notes.title: Achievements
notes.content: You may have noticed that achievements are visible online on the game page. I've entered them all on the website and am now working on getting the code to work with them properly. When this is done (hopefully this week), I will add more to this announcement :).

notes.title: Latest Patch Notes (4/10/2015)
notes.content:
As an update, for those of you who may be seeing a blank screen, I've added an option to disable some of the advanced graphical features in the settings. If you check this box, restart the game, see if you are able to see the game.

I'm also working on making the extra windows not be separate screens and will post an update when that happens.

notes.title: Feedback and Changes
notes.content:
Thank you to Wuffell and Foamed for your reviews on the game. I appreciate both the positive and negative feedback.

My goal was to make a simple and fun rogue-like with sounds and graphics. It seems I have achieved that. Seeing the other things you guys have brought up gives me some things to work on for an update patch.

I appreciate you taking the time out of your days to give feedback and things I can change to make the game better.

notes.title: Release Day
notes.content:
Tower of Eglathia is officially ready for download on Steam. I'm really excited about this. It was almost 2 years ago that I put the game on Steam for Greenlight and a couple months ago, I got the email that said my game had been approved.

I've always wanted to make a rogue-like game and am thrilled to see it available for purchase now. I can't wait to see what you all think of it.
